instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium close-up at eye-level with a shallow depth of field. In an outdoor European street, the blonde woman in the gray turtleneck (R1) stands on the left, smiling widely towards the camera. Next to her, the man in the tan corduroy jacket (R2) stands on the right, smiling. The man (R2) extends his arm forward, holding a white smartphone that is blurred in the immediate foreground to take a selfie of them both. The scene is lit by soft, natural daylight, casting gentle highlights on their faces.
